ledger.purpose: Write-as-you-go OK/ERROR ledger for the five-layer security audit. Each key is written when its layer completes, so a layer that never ran leaves its key ABSENT instead of looking successful. A missing status is a FAILURE under verification check 15, never an implicit OK, and is never backfilled with a guess.
ledger.key_equivalence_note: The four *_status keys are the pre-agent set check 15 names verbatim; the six short-form keys are exactly findings-merged.json _summary.layer_status, so the merge populates all six from here with zero drift and invents nothing. Equivalent keys always carry the same value. layer_1 and layer_3b have no *_status form because check 15's *_status set covers the pre-agent layers only.
ledger.absent_key_semantics: A key absent here means that layer recorded no status; check 15 reads that as FAILURE, not as success.
ledger.write_discipline: Ordered and evidence-gated: each key was written only after that layer's criterion was re-verified against that layer's own artifacts, and this file was re-emitted after every step, so its content is the accumulated end state of those writes (IR3).
ledger.gate_contract: Any ERROR here fires the gate's ERROR branch, which outranks BLOCK, WARN and PASS in strict precedence. A layer documented ERROR here may legitimately lack its normalized findings artifact (checks 3 and 10) and contributes zero to the merged summary's expected counts (check 11).
ledger.error_reason_convention: An ERROR is always accompanied by an error_reason on its layer record and a specific reason in run-metadata.txt. A status is never left unexplained.

syntax_scan_completeness.consumer_note: Every findings-layer-2-semgrep.json record carries file_parse_complete, so consumers can filter by whether a finding's file parsed in full.

evidence.test_partition_note: Verification check 6 requires only that the two test inventories exist. The 19-sink and 9-mitigation coverage obligation is asserted over the primary partition, so a category unrepresented in a test partition is not a defect.
